exact_match.name: Exact Statutory Identity
exact_match.comment: Exact Statutory Identity: Zero variance across GSTIN, Invoice Number, Date, and ITC Financials

commercial_tolerance.name: Commercial Value Tolerance (±₹10)
commercial_tolerance.comment: Commercial Tolerance Match: Financial variance within allowable policy tolerance

date_proximity.name: Document Date Proximity (±30 Days)
date_proximity.comment: Document Date Proximity: Document booked late due to operational dispatch delay (within allowable ±30-day window)

cross_fy.name: Cross-Financial Year Boundary (March 31 vs April 2)
cross_fy.comment: Cross-Financial Year Boundary Timing Difference: Invoice dated in previous FY (March 31) and booked/received in subsequent FY (April 2)

prefix_normalization.name: Document Number Prefix Normalization
prefix_normalization.comment: Document Number Normalization: Invoice prefix/formatting dropped during manual booking ('INV/2026/' stripped to match internal reference)

compound_variation.name: Compound Multi-Parameter Variation
compound_variation.comment: Compound Variation Match: Simultaneous prefix formatting variation and document date delay

ineligible_itc_17_5.name: Section 17(5) Ineligible ITC / Blocked Credit
ineligible_itc_17_5.comment: Section 17(5) Ineligible ITC / Rejected Goods: Full invoice reported in GSTR-2B; only eligible portion booked in PR (ineligible/blocked credit u/s 17(5) not booked in books)

multi_tranche_banking.name: Banking & Multi-Tranche Batch (N:1 & 1:N) Consolidation
multi_tranche_banking.comment: Consolidated Multi-Tranche Entry: Multiple supplier invoices consolidated into single PR voucher within rolling window (e.g. Bank charges / vendor tranche)

ambiguous_collisions.name: Ambiguous Duplicate Collisions
ambiguous_collisions.comment: Ambiguity / Tolerance Collision: Quarantined for review

gst_only.name: GSTR-2B Only (Unclaimed Portal Credit)
gst_only.comment: Portal Credit Available (Unrecorded in Books): Supplier filed in GSTR-1/2B but voucher missing or not entered in Purchase Register

pr_only.name: Purchase Register (Books) Only (Missing in 2B)
pr_only.comment: Internal Books Voucher Only (Unmatched in Portal): Missing in GSTR-2B; DRC-01C compliance notice risk if claimed without vendor filing
